ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; dark pixels (low-intensity) dominate approximately 90-95% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity white pixels localized to specific surface scars and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-black base; high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs visible on the right lobe including a distinct circular ring ('O' shape) and a vertical bar ('I' shape); scattered punctate white markings on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 75 degrees; depth is distinct, clearly separating the two symmetric lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-8 pixel peaks) along the entire trailing edge boundary; topography is highly irregular and jagged, particularly toward the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex outer boundaries; trailing edges follow a generally horizontal-to-upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the right lobe surface; one prominent 'O' shaped ring in the central-right region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) on the upper sections of both lobes, primarily oriented vertically or diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; prominent white scarring on the right lobe including distinct alphanumeric-like shapes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least three pinniped (seal) heads visible in the foreground at the water-line; one seal is positioned directly below the fluke's median notch.
